rooms.name: Sky Lobby / Reception
rooms.notes: Central sky-lobby acting as the social heart of the top floor; full-height glass curtain-wall providing panoramic views over Bangalore. Vastu: reception/entry positioned facing east where circular geometry permits.

rooms.name: Master Bedroom
rooms.notes: Premium master suite on top residential floor; curved perimeter wall with floor-to-ceiling glass; south-west quadrant of circular plate for privacy.

rooms.name: Master Bathroom (En-suite)
rooms.notes: En-suite to master bedroom; wet-zone with natural ventilation shaft in core.

rooms.name: Bedroom 1
rooms.notes: Secondary bedroom with curved exterior glazing; north-east quadrant for morning light.

rooms.name: Bedroom 2
rooms.notes: Third bedroom / guest room; north-west quadrant of floor plate.

rooms.name: Common Bathroom
rooms.notes: Shared bathroom for Bedroom 1 & 2; inner zone adjacent to service core.

rooms.name: Study / Home Office
rooms.notes: Quiet work zone; east-facing for morning natural light; double-glazed for acoustic separation from sky-lobby.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.notes: Open-plan kitchen; service connections via central core; exhaust shaft integrated with MEP riser.

rooms.name: Dining Area
rooms.notes: Dining flows into sky-lobby / lounge zone; curved glazed wall provides views.

rooms.name: Private Balcony (Master Suite)
rooms.notes: Cantilevered curved balcony off master bedroom; glass railing per NBC Part 4 Cl. 5; seismic zone II detailing.

rooms.name: Terrace Garden / Sky Garden
rooms.notes: Wrap-around terrace garden on top floor; rainwater harvesting planters integrated; preparation layer for rooftop solar panels above; soft-scape with native Bangalore species; full circular perimeter per massing intent.

rooms.name: Central Corridor / Landing
rooms.notes: Radial corridor wrapping central core; 1.5 m clear min per NBC Part 3; connects all residential rooms to core lifts and stair.

rooms.name: Utility / Laundry
rooms.notes: Laundry and domestic storage; inner zone near service shaft; MEP connections for washing appliances.

rooms.name: Store
rooms.notes: General storage for residents; inner dark zone; NBC min 1.0 sqm, sized up for usability.

response.floor_summary: Floor 4 is the premium residential top floor of the circular mixed-use tower, featuring a sky-lobby opening onto a wrap-around terrace garden, a master suite with en-suite and private balcony, two additional bedrooms sharing a common bathroom, a study, open-plan kitchen-dining, and service spaces — all arranged radially around the central steel core with full-glass curtain-wall façade views over Bangalore.
